title: Ghost Line index.json
description: Line metadata: corners, pairs, service date, feed info, and sources.

effective.description: Effective date of the 1938 timetable (ISO 8601 date).

corners.description: The timing-point corners in route order.

service_date.description: The GTFS service date used for today's trips (ISO 8601 date).

feed_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the pinned GTFS zip.

street_order_checked.description: The street_order_checked flag of the 1938 facts file: true once a person has checked the street order against the scans. The credits clause 'checked by hand' depends on this flag alone.

photo_finish_min.description: The photo-finish band in minutes: a race is a photo finish when the two totals differ by less than this (race.PHOTO_FINISH_MIN). Covered by the method source. The site reads it for its photo-finish wording (race-engine task 36).

stop_radius_m.description: The stop radius in metres (stops.DEFAULT_STOP_RADIUS_M): a stop counts for a corner when it is within this geodesic distance. Covered by the method source. The site reads it for the honest-limits line (polish brief P3).

walk_detour_factor.description: The street-detour factor of the walk estimate (stops.DETOUR_FACTOR): straight-line metres are multiplied by it. Covered by the method source. The site reads it for the walk method line (polish brief P3).

walk_speed_m_s.description: The walking speed of the walk estimate in metres per second (stops.WALK_SPEED_M_PER_S). Covered by the method source. The site reads it for the walk method line (polish brief P3).

sources.description: Source-ID catalog for the whole data set. Other generated files carry a top-level 'sources' object that maps their blocks to arrays of these IDs. Coverage in this file: corners (slug, name, lonlat, inferred, note) are covered by guide1938_diagram, guide1938_route and osm, and by the existing inference notes on each corner; effective is covered by guide1938_timetable; service_date, feed_version and feed_sha256 are covered by mta_gtfs; pairs is derived from corners and covered by method. Whether every ID used elsewhere resolves here, and recursive numeric coverage, are checked by the emitter and check_sources, not by this schema.

mta_gtfs.description: MDOT MTA local bus GTFS. The entry's 'where' must state feed_version 20260821, the pinned SHA-256 and service date 2026-11-04 (weekday schedule, service_id 2251).

osm.description: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The entry's 'where' must state the data/osm/ways.json snapshot date (2026-11-01).

method.description: Computation method documented in the project (walk formula, 400 m radius, 1.0-minute photo-finish band). year and url may be null.

slug.description: URL-safe hyphenated identifier for the corner.

inferred.description: True when the position was inferred rather than taken from a primary source.

note.description: Optional explanatory note; null if none.

label.description: Human-readable source name shown beside its link, for example '1938 route diagram, Digital Maryland'.

where.description: Page, feed or file within the source.
